column4: of whom the world was not worthy—wandering in deserts, mountains, caves, and the holes of the earth.
column5: (Of whom the world was not worthy:) they wandered in deserts, and in mountains, and in dens and caves of the earth.

column4: These all, having had testimony given to them through their faith, didn’t receive the promise,
column5: And these all, having obtained a good report through faith, received not the promise:

column4: God having provided some better thing concerning us, so that apart from us they should not be made perfect.
column5: God having provided some better thing for us, that they without us should not be made perfect.

column4: Therefore let’s also, seeing we are surrounded by so great a cloud of witnesses, lay aside every weight and the sin which so easily entangles us, and let’s run with perseverance the race that is set before us,
column5: Wherefore seeing we also are compassed about with so great a cloud of witnesses, let us lay aside every weight, and the sin which doth so easily beset us , and let us run with patience the race that is set before us,

column4: looking to Jesus, the author and perfecter of faith, who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising its shame, and has sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.
column5: Looking unto Jesus the author and finisher of our faith; who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising the shame, and is set down at the right hand of the throne of God.

column4: For consider him who has endured such contradiction of sinners against himself, that you don’t grow weary, fainting in your souls.
column5: For consider him that endured such contradiction of sinners against himself, lest ye be wearied and faint in your minds.

column4: You have not yet resisted to blood, striving against sin.
column5: Ye have not yet resisted unto blood, striving against sin.

column4: You have forgotten the exhortation which reasons with you as with children, “My son, don’t take lightly the chastening of the Lord, nor faint when you are reproved by him;
column5: And ye have forgotten the exhortation which speaketh unto you as unto children, My son, despise not thou the chastening of the Lord, nor faint when thou art rebuked of him:

column4: for whom the Lord loves, he disciplines, and chastises every son whom he receives.”
column5: For whom the Lord loveth he chasteneth, and scourgeth every son whom he receiveth.

column4: It is for discipline that you endure. God deals with you as with children, for what son is there whom his father doesn’t discipline?
column5: If ye endure chastening, God dealeth with you as with sons; for what son is he whom the father chasteneth not?

column4: But if you are without discipline, of which all have been made partakers, then you are illegitimate, and not children.
column5: But if ye be without chastisement, whereof all are partakers, then are ye bastards, and not sons.

column4: Furthermore, we had the fathers of our flesh to chasten us, and we paid them respect. Shall we not much rather be in subjection to the Father of spirits, and live?
column5: Furthermore we have had fathers of our flesh which corrected us , and we gave them reverence: shall we not much rather be in subjection unto the Father of spirits, and live?

column4: For they indeed, for a few days, punished us as seemed good to them; but he for our profit, that we may be partakers of his holiness.
column5: For they verily for a few days chastened us after their own pleasure; but he for our profit, that we might be partakers of his holiness.

column4: All chastening seems for the present to be not joyous but grievous; yet afterward it yields the peaceful fruit of righteousness to those who have been trained by it.
column5: Now no chastening for the present seemeth to be joyous, but grievous: nevertheless afterward it yieldeth the peaceable fruit of righteousness unto them which are exercised thereby.

column4: Therefore lift up the hands that hang down and the feeble knees,
column5: Wherefore lift up the hands which hang down, and the feeble knees;

column4: and make straight paths for your feet, so what is lame may not be dislocated, but rather be healed.
column5: And make straight paths for your feet, lest that which is lame be turned out of the way; but let it rather be healed.

column4: Follow after peace with all men, and the sanctification without which no man will see the Lord,
column5: Follow peace with all men , and holiness, without which no man shall see the Lord:

column4: looking carefully lest there be any man who falls short of the grace of God, lest any root of bitterness springing up trouble you, and many be defiled by it,
column5: Looking diligently lest any man fail of the grace of God; lest any root of bitterness springing up trouble you , and thereby many be defiled;

column4: lest there be any sexually immoral person, or profane person, like Esau, who sold his birthright for one meal.
column5: Lest there be any fornicator, or profane person, as Esau, who for one morsel of meat sold his birthright.

column4: For you know that even when he afterward desired to inherit the blessing, he was rejected, for he found no place for a change of mind though he sought it diligently with tears.
column5: For ye know how that afterward, when he would have inherited the blessing, he was rejected: for he found no place of repentance, though he sought it carefully with tears.

column4: For you have not come to a mountain that might be touched, and that burned with fire, and to blackness, darkness, storm,
column5: For ye are not come unto the mount that might be touched, and that burned with fire, nor unto blackness, and darkness, and tempest,

column4: the sound of a trumpet, and the voice of words; which those who heard it begged that not one more word should be spoken to them,
column5: And the sound of a trumpet, and the voice of words; which voice they that heard intreated that the word should not be spoken to them any more:

column4: for they could not stand that which was commanded, “If even an animal touches the mountain, it shall be stoned”.
column5: (For they could not endure that which was commanded, And if so much as a beast touch the mountain, it shall be stoned, or thrust through with a dart:

column4: So fearful was the appearance that Moses said, “I am terrified and trembling.”
column5: And so terrible was the sight, that Moses said, I exceedingly fear and quake:)

column4: But you have come to Mount Zion, and to the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem, and to innumerable multitudes of angels,
column5: But ye are come unto mount Sion, and unto the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem, and to an innumerable company of angels,

column4: to the festal gathering and assembly of the firstborn who are enrolled in heaven, to God the Judge of all, to the spirits of just men made perfect,
column5: To the general assembly and church of the firstborn, which are written in heaven, and to God the Judge of all, and to the spirits of just men made perfect,

column4: to Jesus, the mediator of a new covenant, and to the blood of sprinkling that speaks better than that of Abel.
column5: And to Jesus the mediator of the new covenant, and to the blood of sprinkling, that speaketh better things than that of Abel.

column4: See that you don’t refuse him who speaks. For if they didn’t escape when they refused him who warned on the earth, how much more will we not escape who turn away from him who warns from heaven,
column5: See that ye refuse not him that speaketh. For if they escaped not who refused him that spake on earth, much more shall not we escape , if we turn away from him that speaketh from heaven:

column4: whose voice shook the earth then, but now he has promised, saying, “Yet once more I will shake not only the earth, but also the heavens.”
column5: Whose voice then shook the earth: but now he hath promised, saying, Yet once more I shake not the earth only, but also heaven.

column4: This phrase, “Yet once more” signifies the removing of those things that are shaken, as of things that have been made, that those things which are not shaken may remain.
column5: And this word , Yet once more, signifieth the removing of those things that are shaken, as of things that are made, that those things which cannot be shaken may remain.

column4: Therefore, receiving a Kingdom that can’t be shaken, let’s have grace, through which we serve God acceptably, with reverence and awe,
column5: Wherefore we receiving a kingdom which cannot be moved, let us have grace, whereby we may serve God acceptably with reverence and godly fear:

column4: for our God is a consuming fire.
column5: For our God is a consuming fire.

column4: Let brotherly love continue.
column5: Let brotherly love continue.

column4: Don’t forget to show hospitality to strangers, for in doing so, some have entertained angels without knowing it.
column5: Be not forgetful to entertain strangers: for thereby some have entertained angels unawares.

column4: Remember those who are in bonds, as bound with them, and those who are ill-treated, since you are also in the body.
column5: Remember them that are in bonds, as bound with them; and them which suffer adversity, as being yourselves also in the body.

column4: Let marriage be held in honor among all, and let the bed be undefiled; but God will judge the sexually immoral and adulterers.
column5: Marriage is honourable in all, and the bed undefiled: but whoremongers and adulterers God will judge.

column4: Be free from the love of money, content with such things as you have, for he has said, “I will in no way leave you, neither will I in any way forsake you.”
column5: Let your conversation be without covetousness; and be content with such things as ye have: for he hath said, I will never leave thee, nor forsake thee.

column4: So that with good courage we say, “The Lord is my helper. I will not fear. What can man do to me?”
column5: So that we may boldly say, The Lord is my helper, and I will not fear what man shall do unto me.

column4: Remember your leaders, men who spoke to you the word of God, and considering the results of their conduct, imitate their faith.
column5: Remember them which have the rule over you, who have spoken unto you the word of God: whose faith follow, considering the end of their conversation.

column4: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, today, and forever.
column5: Jesus Christ the same yesterday, and to day, and for ever.

column4: Don’t be carried away by various and strange teachings, for it is good that the heart be established by grace, not by food, through which those who were so occupied were not benefited.
column5: Be not carried about with divers and strange doctrines. For it is a good thing that the heart be established with grace; not with meats, which have not profited them that have been occupied therein.

column4: We have an altar from which those who serve the holy tabernacle have no right to eat.
column5: We have an altar, whereof they have no right to eat which serve the tabernacle.

column4: For the bodies of those animals, whose blood is brought into the holy place by the high priest as an offering for sin, are burned outside of the camp.
column5: For the bodies of those beasts, whose blood is brought into the sanctuary by the high priest for sin, are burned without the camp.

column4: Therefore Jesus also, that he might sanctify the people through his own blood, suffered outside of the gate.
column5: Wherefore Jesus also, that he might sanctify the people with his own blood, suffered without the gate.

column4: Let’s therefore go out to him outside of the camp, bearing his reproach.
column5: Let us go forth therefore unto him without the camp, bearing his reproach.

column4: For we don’t have here an enduring city, but we seek that which is to come.
column5: For here have we no continuing city, but we seek one to come.

column4: Through him, then, let’s offer up a sacrifice of praise to God continually, that is, the fruit of lips which proclaim allegiance to his name.
column5: By him therefore let us offer the sacrifice of praise to God continually, that is, the fruit of our lips giving thanks to his name.

column4: But don’t forget to be doing good and sharing, for with such sacrifices God is well pleased.
column5: But to do good and to communicate forget not: for with such sacrifices God is well pleased.

column4: Obey your leaders and submit to them, for they watch on behalf of your souls, as those who will give account, that they may do this with joy, and not with groaning, for that would be unprofitable for you.
column5: Obey them that have the rule over you, and submit yourselves: for they watch for your souls, as they that must give account, that they may do it with joy, and not with grief: for that is unprofitable for you.

column4: Pray for us, for we are persuaded that we have a good conscience, desiring to live honorably in all things.
column5: Pray for us: for we trust we have a good conscience, in all things willing to live honestly.

column4: I strongly urge you to do this, that I may be restored to you sooner.
column5: But I beseech you the rather to do this, that I may be restored to you the sooner.

column4: Now may the God of peace, who brought again from the dead the great shepherd of the sheep with the blood of an eternal covenant, our Lord Jesus,
column5: Now the God of peace, that brought again from the dead our Lord Jesus, that great shepherd of the sheep, through the blood of the everlasting covenant,

column4: make you complete in every good work to do his will, working in you that which is well pleasing in his sight, through Jesus Christ, to whom be the glory forever and ever. Amen.
column5: Make you perfect in every good work to do his will, working in you that which is wellpleasing in his sight, through Jesus Christ; to whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.

column4: But I exhort you, brothers, endure the word of exhortation; for I have written to you in few words.
column5: And I beseech you, brethren, suffer the word of exhortation: for I have written a letter unto you in few words.

column4: Know that our brother Timothy has been freed, with whom, if he comes shortly, I will see you.
column5: Know ye that our brother Timothy is set at liberty; with whom, if he come shortly, I will see you.

column4: Greet all of your leaders and all the saints. The Italians greet you.
column5: Salute all them that have the rule over you, and all the saints. They of Italy salute you.

column4: Grace be with you all. Amen.
column5: Grace be with you all. Amen.
